name: Gemini 3.6 Flash
description: Gemini 3.6 Flash is Google's fast multimodal model for high-throughput agentic and general-purpose workloads.

details.name: availability_note
details.value: Google Cloud exposes Gemini 3.6 Flash SKUs globally.

details.name: capability_note
details.value: AI Studio describes Gemini 3.6 Flash as balancing speed with intelligence for agentic and multimodal tasks.

details.name: pricing
details.value: Introductory Standard pricing is $0.75 input, $0.075 cached input, and $3.75 output per 1M tokens through December 31, 2026. Standard pricing doubles to $1.50 input, $0.15 cached input, and $7.50 output on January 1, 2027. Batch and Flex remain 50% of Standard; Priority is priced at 1.8x Standard.
